subject: Re: HITNet status: decision for LRB on June 11
body:
All,

Decisions for the June 11 Launch Review Board:

1. We demo the custom-CUDA-op model. Farah landed the full kernel set on June 2 and we're at 31 ms/frame - inside the real-time budget. Great work.
2. Variable disparity range is explicitly out of scope; the LRB one-pager says 'fixed-range models (128-400), variable range in a later release'. No verbal promises beyond that please.
3. Middlebury half-resolution models are what we show for high-detail scenes; we do not upsample and imply full-res quality.

Remaining ask before the 11th: Wei to freeze the eval table (EPE + latency, all three datasets), Umar to write the two-paragraph limitations section. Deshawn keeps Farah's June allocation as planned through demo hardening.

If LRB signs off, Q3 goal becomes onboarding two internal consumers.

Dmitri
